# Breadcrumbs

**Figma:** Breadcrumbs (4031:20161), Primitives/Breadcrumbs/Item/Slot (4031:20158), .Primitives/Breadcrumbs/Item (292:43787)  
**Import:** `import { Breadcrumbs } from "@zen/design-system";`

Show where the current page sits in a hierarchy and let users go up.

## Use it for
- Pages 3+ levels deep; file browsers.

## Use something else for
- Flat apps or step flows.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | default · medium |
| Level | `master` | first item with icon |
| Collapse | `maxItems` | first + last N, “…” expands |
| Navigate | `onNavigate` | preventDefault for client routing |

## Props

### Breadcrumbs
Figma Breadcrumbs (4031:20161): Item-List with chevron separators (icon-chevron-right-line-small, Neutral/Light).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (required) | `BreadcrumbItemData[]` | — |  |
| `emphasis` | `"default" \| "medium"` | `"default"` |  |
| `master` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the first item as the Master level (with icon). Default true. |
| `maxItems` | `number` | — | Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis button when there are more than this many. Activating the ellipsis shows them all and moves focus to the first crumb it revealed. |
| `onNavigate` | `(item: BreadcrumbItemData, event: MouseEvent) => void` | — | Called for every non-current item; call `event.preventDefault()` for client-side routing. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | — | Names the navigation landmark (default "Breadcrumb", from the locale's labels). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

## Keyboard
| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Shift+Tab | Move between links |
| Enter | Go to the page |

## ✅ Do
- Make the last item the current page (not a link).
- Collapse long paths with maxItems.
- Use the same labels as page titles.
- Start with the root (Home or the workspace) and use the master item's icon only there.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't use breadcrumbs as the only navigation.
- Don't highlight the master icon on its own on hover: the whole item takes Neutral/Flat/Hover and the icon stays Neutral/Strongest.
- Don't include the current page as a link.
- Don't show breadcrumbs on top-level pages (only one item).

## Accessibility
- nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" + ordered list; aria-current=page.
- Activating “…” (Show N more) reveals the hidden crumbs and moves focus to the first crumb it revealed, so keyboard users continue down the trail.

## Content
- Short page names.
